counties.notes: Oklahoma County is Oklahoma's most populous county (pop. 810,000; county seat Oklahoma City). The TaxParcelsPublics_view FeatureServer is hosted on ArcGIS Online (services8.arcgis.com, org ID euhkr1dAJeQBIjV0) and published via the OK County GIS Hub at ok-county-gis-hub-ok-co.hub.arcgis.com. Live query confirmed 336,922 parcels and owner-name exposure. Key fields: accountno (R-prefixed account number, e.g. 'R189878000'), name1/name2/name3 (up to three owners), mailingaddress1, city (mailing city), location (combined property address when populated, e.g. '17622 N INDIAN MERIDIAN RD OKLAHOMA CITY'), locationcity (property city), propertyid (numeric internal ID), taxdistrict, taxdistrictname, currentmarket, currentassessed, currenttaxable, landvalue, legal (legal description), subname, lot, block, section, township, range, acreage. Note: location and locationcity fields may be null for some rural parcels, when null, use legal/section/township/range for location. The former county ArcGIS Server at oklahomacounty.geocortex.com is no longer reachable (DNS fails as of 2026-06); the ArcGIS Online hosted view is the current canonical public layer. Oklahoma County Assessor portal at assessor.oklahomacounty.org provides the full record with appeals and valuation history.
